annotation.venue: 江苏省人民代表大会常务委员会公报
annotation.summary_en: Gazette of Jiangsu's provincial legislature, 2023 No. 8, compiling laws adopted on 29 Nov 2023. Embodied-AI-relevant: the Decision on Promoting Internet of Vehicles and Intelligent Connected Vehicles (effective 1 Jan 2024), with drafting reports. Also contains unrelated local regulations, personnel appointments and speeches.
key_provisions_or_claims: Decision promotes IoV and intelligent connected vehicles under principles of innovation, inclusive prudence, application-driven and safe order; effective 1 Jan 2024.
Municipalities may designate road test, demonstration and commercial pilot zones; vehicles must connect to data platforms.
Enterprises must implement cybersecurity classified protection and data classification; important data and personal information stored in China.
Producers and sellers responsible for product quality and must provide rescue support; traffic violations handled under existing road safety law.
Unmanned delivery and cleaning equipment on roads treated by reference to non-motor vehicle rules; detailed rules by departments.
